Hi! Development is still ongoing, so the description isn’t final yet.

The CAR Medkit isn’t intentionally excluded. If it uses the same healing mechanism as other Medkits in SPT 4.0.13, it will also be supported. I’ll update the description to reflect the final list before the full release.
